verses.original: τοῦτο Τρίτον ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς πᾶν ῥῆμα σταθήσεται Ἐπὶ στόματος δύο καὶ τριῶν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: touto Triton erchomai pros hymas pan rhēma stathēsetai Epi stomatos dyo kai triōn martyrōn
verses.literal: This [is] [the] third [time] I am coming to you Every matter must be established by [the] testimony of two or three witnesses

verses.original: Προείρηκα καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ὡς παρὼν καὶ νῦν ἀπὼν προλέγω τοῖς προημαρτηκόσιν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς λοιποῖς ὅτι ἐὰν ἔλθω εἰς τὸ πάλιν οὐ φείσομαι
verses.transliteration: Proeirēka kai to deuteron hōs parōn kai nyn apōn prolegō tois proēmartēkosin kai pasin tois loipois hoti ean elthō eis to palin ou pheisomai
verses.literal: I already warned [you] . . . the second time vvv I was [with you] [So] now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone - else - If I return vvv vvv vvv vvv I will not spare [anyone]

verses.original: ἐπεὶ ζητεῖτε δοκιμὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ λαλοῦντος ἐν ἐμοὶ ὃς οὐκ ἀσθενεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς ἀλλὰ δυνατεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: epei zēteite dokimēn tou Christou lalountos en emoi hos ouk asthenei eis hymas alla dynatei en hymin
verses.literal: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me [He] vvv is not weak in dealing with you but is powerful among you

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ ἐσταυρώθη ἐξ ἀσθενείας ἀλλὰ ζῇ ἐκ Θεοῦ δυνάμεως γὰρ ἡμεῖς καὶ ἀσθενοῦμεν ἐν αὐτῷ ἀλλὰ ἐκ Θεοῦ δυνάμεως ζήσομεν σὺν αὐτῷ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar kai estaurōthē ex astheneias alla zē ek Theou dynameōs gar hēmeis kai asthenoumen en autō alla ek Theou dynameōs zēsomen syn autō eis hymas
verses.literal: For vvv He was indeed crucified in weakness yet He lives by God’s power For we are also weak in Him yet by God’s power we will live with Him concerning you

verses.original: πειράζετε Ἑαυτοὺς εἰ ἐστὲ ἐν τῇ πίστει δοκιμάζετε ἑαυτοὺς ἢ οὐκ ἐπιγινώσκετε ἑαυτοὺς ὅτι Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μήτι ἐστε ἀδόκιμοί
verses.transliteration: peirazete Heautous ei este en tē pistei dokimazete heautous ē ouk epiginōskete heautous hoti Iēsous Christos en hymin ei mēti este adokimoi
verses.literal: Examine yourselves [to see] whether you are in the faith test yourselves vvv Do you not realize - that Jesus Christ [is] in you unless . . . you fail the test

verses.original: δὲ ἐλπίζω ὅτι γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἐσμὲν οὐκ ἀδόκιμοι
verses.transliteration: de elpizō hoti gnōsesthe hoti hēmeis esmen ouk adokimoi
verses.literal: And I hope - you will realize that we have not failed the test

verses.original: δὲ Εὐχόμεθα πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὑμᾶς μὴ ποιῆσαι μηδέν κακὸν οὐχ ἵνα ἡμεῖς φανῶμεν δόκιμοι ἀλλ’ ἵνα ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε τὸ καλὸν δὲ ἡμεῖς ὦμεν ὡς ἀδόκιμοι
verses.transliteration: de Euchometha pros ton Theon hymas mē poiēsai mēden kakon ouch hina hēmeis phanōmen dokimoi all’ hina hymeis poiēte to kalon de hēmeis ōmen hōs adokimoi
verses.literal: Now we pray to - God [that] you vvv will not do [anything] wrong not that we will appear to have stood the test but that you will do what [is] right even if we appear to have failed

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ δυνάμεθά τι κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: gar ou dynametha ti kata tēs alētheias alla hyper tēs alētheias
verses.literal: For vvv we cannot do anything against the truth but only for the truth

verses.original: γὰρ χαίρομεν ὅταν ἡμεῖς ἀσθενῶμεν δὲ ὑμεῖς ἦτε δυνατοὶ τοῦτο καὶ εὐχόμεθα ὑμῶν τὴν κατάρτισιν
verses.transliteration: gar chairomen hotan hēmeis asthenōmen de hymeis ēte dynatoi touto kai euchometha hymōn tēn katartisin
verses.literal: In fact we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong - and our prayer is for your - perfection

verses.original: τοῦτο Διὰ γράφω ταῦτα ἀπὼν ἵνα παρὼν μὴ χρήσωμαι ἀποτόμως κατὰ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἣν ὁ Κύριος ἔδωκέν μοι εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν
verses.transliteration: touto Dia graphō tauta apōn hina parōn mē chrēsōmai apotomōs kata tēn exousian hēn ho Kyrios edōken moi eis oikodomēn kai ouk eis kathairesin
verses.literal: This is why . . . I write these things while absent so that when I am present vvv I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building [you] up - not for tearing [you] down

verses.original: Λοιπόν ἀδελφοί χαίρετε καταρτίζεσθε παρακαλεῖσθε τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε εἰρηνεύετε καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Loipon adelphoi chairete katartizesthe parakaleisthe to auto phroneite eirēneuete kai ho Theos tēs agapēs kai eirēnēs estai meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: Finally brothers rejoice Aim for perfect harmony encourage one another [be of] one mind live in peace And the God - of love and peace will be with you
Greet one another with a holy kiss
All the saints send you greetings . . .

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ κοινωνία τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai hē agapē tou Theou kai hē koinōnia tou Hagiou Pneumatos meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit [be] with all of you
